title: Scalar relative differential invariants
summary: Computation of polynomial relative invariants is a classical tool in algebra. Relative differential invariants are central for the equivalence problem of geometric structures. We address the fundamental problem of finite generation of their (differential) algebra and demonstrate both positive and negative results in this respect under various setups. As in the algebraic case, the algebra of polynomial differential invariants is not finitely generated.
